samples.xml_description:
<module id="alu">
    <description>An arithmetic and logic unit (ALU) for a 32-bit MIPS-ISA CPU.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="a" width_description="[31:0]">A 32-bit input operand.</input>
        <input id="b" width_description="[31:0]">Another 32-bit input operand.</input>
        <input id="aluc" width_description="[5:0]">A 6-bit control signal for selecting the operation to be performed.</input>
        <output id="r" width_description="[31:0]">A 32-bit output representing the result of the operation.</output>
        <output id="zero">A 1-bit output indicating whether the result is zero.</output>
        <output id="carry">A 1-bit output indicating whether a carry occurred during the operation.</output>
        <output id="negative">A 1-bit output indicating whether the result is negative.</output>
        <output id="overflow">A 1-bit output indicating whether an overflow occurred during the operation.</output>
        <output id="flag">A 1-bit output representing a general flag, which is set based on specific operations (SLT and SLTU).</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="ADD">6'b100000</parameter>
        <parameter id="ADDU">6'b100001</parameter>
        <parameter id="SUB">6'b100010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SUBU">6'b100011</parameter>
        <parameter id="AND">6'b100100</parameter>
        <parameter id="OR">6'b100101</parameter>
        <parameter id="XOR">6'b100110</parameter>
        <parameter id="NOR">6'b100111</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLT">6'b101010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLTU">6'b101011</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLL">6'b000000</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRL">6'b000010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRA">6'b000011</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLLV">6'b000100</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRLV">6'b000110</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRAV">6'b000111</parameter>
        <parameter id="LUI">6'b001111</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <assign id="signed_a">($signed(a))</assign>
        <assign id="signed_b">($signed(b))</assign>
        <reg id="res" width_description="[31:0]">Result register.</reg>
        <always_comb>
            <case>
                <item id="ADD"><assign res = signed_a + signed_b;</assign></item>
                <item id="ADDU"><assign res = a + b;</assign></item>
                <item id="SUB"><assign res = signed_a - signed_b;</assign></item>
                <item id="SUBU"><assign res = a - b;</assign></item>
                <item id="AND"><assign res = a & b;</assign></item>
                <item id="OR"><assign res = a | b;</assign></item>
                <item id="XOR"><assign res = a ^ b;</assign></item>
                <item id="NOR"><assign res = ~(a | b);</assign></item>
                <item id="SLT"><assign res = ($signed(a) < $signed(b));</assign></item>
                <item id="SLTU"><assign res = (a < b);</assign></item>
                <item id="SLL"><assign res = b << a[4:0];</assign></item>
                <item id="SRL"><assign res = b >> a[4:0];</assign></item>
                <item id="SRA"><assign res = signed_b >>> signed_a[4:0];</assign></item>
                <item id="SLLV"><assign res = b << a[4:0];</assign></item>
                <item id="SRLV"><assign res = b >> a[4:0];</assign></item>
                <item id="SRAV"><assign res = signed_b >>> signed_a[4:0];</assign></item>
                <item id="LUI"><assign res = {a[15:0], 16'h0};</assign></item>
                <default><assign res = 32'hzzzz_zzzz;</assign></default>
            </case>
        </always_comb>
        <assign id="flag">((aluc == SLT || aluc == SLTU) ? 1 : 1'bz)</assign>
        <assign id="zero">(|res ? 0 : 1)</assign>
        <assign id="carry">((aluc == SUB || aluc == SUBU) && (a >= b) ? 0 : ((aluc == SUB || aluc == SUBU) && (a < b) ? 1 : 1'bz))</assign>
        <assign id="negative">res[31]</assign>
        <assign id="overflow">((aluc == ADD || aluc == SUB) && ((signed_a > 0 && signed_b > 0 && res <= 0) || (signed_a < 0 && signed_b < 0 && res >= 0))) ? 1 : (((aluc == ADD || aluc == SUB) && ((signed_a > 0 && signed_b < 0 && res <= 0) || (signed_a < 0 && signed_b > 0 && res >= 0))) ? 0 : 1'bz))</assign>
        <assign id="r">res[31:0]</assign>
    </logic_description>
</module>
